comments.body:
This looks somewhat like:
https://github.com/grpc/grpc/issues/21213
and might be fixed with:
https://github.com/grpc/grpc/pull/21662
This happens to me on Fedora 31 when compiling with clang and it actually happens consistently.
The issue is resolved when switching to from v1.26.0 to [v1.27.0-pre2](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/releases/tag/v1.27.0-pre2).
It also happens reproducible with GCC. How was this not caught by CI?
Still happening, until we update gRPC.
Hey Julian, did you open this because it's still happening with v1.27?

I re-opened this because we did not actually update to v1.27. All #978 had done was just adding a unit test back to CI. And I hoped it would cause CI to fail until we update but the stall somehow did not happen in CI.

Anyway, I think we can close this once that we update to v1.27. I was just waiting on the release which I see has now been made: https://github.com/grpc/grpc/releases. Let me update! :smile:
